hydria.definition:
n. A water jar; esp., one with a large rounded body, a small
   neck, and three handles. Some of the most beautiful Greek vases are of
   this form.
hydria.translation: n. (古希腊一种大身细嘴、有两个小提环及一个大手柄的)提水罐

hydric.definition: a. having or characterized by excessive moisture
hydric.translation: a. 氢气的, 含氢的

hydrics.translation: n. 水学(研究水的性质的物理学分支)

hydride.definition: n. any binary compound formed by the union of hydrogen and other elements

hydrides.definition:
-s form of hydride
n. any binary compound formed by the union of hydrogen and other elements
hydrides.translation: (hydride 的第三人称 -s形式) [医] 氢化物

hydridic.translation: a. [化](氢原子)带一个负电荷的

hydrilla.definition: n. submersed plant with whorled lanceolate leaves and solitary axillary flowers; Old World plant naturalized in southern United States and clogging Florida's waterways
hydrilla.translation: n. [植](20世纪60 年代从亚洲引进美国的) 软水草

hydrilla verticillata.translation: [网络] 黑藻；水王孙；水植物黑藻

hydrindone.translation: 茚满酮, 二氢化茚酮

hydriodic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, hydrogen and iodine; --
   said of an acid produced by the combination of these elements.

hydriodic acid.translation:
[化] 氢碘酸
[医] 氢磺酸

hydriodide.definition:
n. A compound of hydriodic acid with a base; --
   distinguished from an iodide, in which only the iodine combines with
   the base.
